tonight.headline: 0-5, favoured at 71% — two coin flips wait for practice
body: Bad news first: Rice and Barkley, your two best bench players, still have not practised. Tuesday's NBC/Yahoo injury report reads Rice as 'likely out' and Barkley as uncertain; Wednesday's first official report comes after this brief.

Nothing changed overnight on your roster and no claim was placed. The lineup as set projects 116.4 against Los Cachanillas' 79.2; the two coin flips — Rice for Pickens, Barkley for Tuten — stay where Tuesday left them.

case.label: Why you are favoured
case.body: Three of their starters are on bye and Montgomery is out. ESPN gives you 71% on the lineup as set.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Barkley started on a Friday questionable tag and ruled out at 09:30 with only Kamara behind him; or Loveland's quarterback turning out to be Bagent.

doFirst.title: Rice into the flex for Pickens, if he is active
doFirst.subtitle: A 0.7 coin flip that goes to the projection. Pickens plays Sunday night, so he is the fallback.

case.label: The call
case.body: 14.4 against 13.7: inside the coin-flip line, so the projection decides and no thesis is written.

case.label: The doubt
case.body: A hamstring from Week 4. Rapoport 'relatively minor' (DK Network, 13 Oct); Silver 'could be out several weeks' (NBC, 4 Oct); Tuesday's NBC/Yahoo report reads him as 'likely out'. No practice since; the first report is Wednesday afternoon.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Rice limited or out all week: Pickens stays. Either way, decide at 12:55 Sunday.

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Fallback only · decide by Sun 07:30 (Tuten's London kickoff)
doFirst.title: Barkley for Tuten only if Friday's report clears him
doFirst.subtitle: The projection prefers Barkley by 0.7, but Tuten locks two hours before Barkley's inactives are known.

case.label: The clock
case.body: Tuten kicks off at 07:30 in London; Barkley's inactives come at 09:30. Start Barkley on a questionable tag and lose him at 09:30, and the only fallback is Kamara (10.1) — not Tuten.

case.label: The player
case.body: Sirianni 'hopeful'; Garafolo says he 'has a shot' pending practice (Forbes, 13 Oct). Shipley doubtful and Bigsby on IR, so if he plays the role is his.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: No designation on Friday's report: make the swap. Questionable or worse: Tuten stays.

whatWentWrong.title: The lineup tool's Barkley contingency cannot be executed
whatWentWrong.lead: It names Tuten as Barkley's fallback at 09:30 Sunday; Tuten's game started at 07:30.

case.label: Why it matters
case.body: Taking the coin flip blind means a questionable Barkley with only Kamara behind him. The decision has to move to Friday's report — the second card.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Barkley removed from the report on Friday, which makes the swap safe.

worthALook.name: Brenton Strange
worthALook.lead: Lawrence's top target; the seat reopens at 15:52 UTC today.

case.label: The role
case.body: 26.2% target share over the last two weeks, 14 catches on 16 targets (NFL.com, 13 Oct).

case.label: Why not today
case.body: 9.8 against Loveland's 8.5 is a coin flip, and Rapoport now gives Williams 'a pretty good chance' of starting for Chicago (Bleacher Nation, 13 Oct), which weakens the case.

case.label: When to act
case.body: Chicago name Bagent or Keenum for Atlanta — Johnson is expected to wait until Friday: add Strange (a free agent now) for Loveland. Jacksonville's Week 7 bye would cost him that week.

worthALook.name: Pat Freiermuth
worthALook.lead: Carried: Pittsburgh are down three receivers.

case.label: The role
case.body: Pittman on IR, Roman Wilson and Skowronek ruled out for Week 6 (Forbes, 13 Oct); 21.5 points on 8 targets in Week 5 (archive).

case.label: What would change it
case.body: A second game of seven targets at Tampa — then he and Strange are the two candidates for Loveland's seat.

worthALook.name: Woody Marks
worthALook.lead: A free agent now: Houston's back while Montgomery is out, and Tuten is on bye in Week 7.

case.label: The role
case.body: Montgomery week-to-week with a groin (Ryans); Marks and Ogunbowale the only healthy backs (WagerTalk, 14 Oct). Forbes calls Marks a must-start while Montgomery is out.

case.label: Why not tonight
case.body: 10.8 does not beat Taylor or Tuten this week, and the only RB drops on the roster are on the exposure list. Strategy: solve the Jacksonville bye in Week 7.

case.label: When to act
case.body: Next Tuesday, with Week 7 projections, if he is still free.

worthALook.name: Ravens D/ST

case.label: The case
case.body: Home to Cleveland; Judkins day-to-day and Concepcion in the concussion protocol (DK Network/Forbes, 13 Oct). A free agent costs no priority.

case.label: When to act
